sources.citation: Qili Liu, Damiano Baccarella, Brendan McGann, Tonghun Lee, Dual-Mode Operation and Transition in Axisymmetric Scramjets, AIAA Journal 57(11) (2019) 4764-4777.
Qili Liu, Damiano Baccarella, Gyu-Sub Lee, Tonghun Lee, Influences of Cavity on Combustion Stabilization in an Axisymmetric Scramjet, AIAA SciTech Forum (2019), AIAA 2019-1681.
Hang Liu, Wei Yao, LES investigation of nonequilibrium flow in a cavity-flameholding axisymmetric scramjet, AIAA Propulsion and Energy Forum 2021, AIAA 2021-3536.
sources.role: independent full-scale reconstruction of the Liu axisymmetric geometry; used for dimensional cross-checks only

derived_geometry_consistency.interpretation: Three independent dimensional identities close consistently: 37.43 mm inlet + 254 mm isolator gives the 291.4 mm injector station to 0.03 mm; 254 mm + 42 mm gives the independently reported 296 mm constant-diameter run to the cavity leading edge exactly; and the cavity-floor/ramp projection plus 357 mm diverging section reconstructs the reported overall length to sub-millimetre residuals. These are rounding-level residuals, not free fitting parameters.

model_B_corollary.SRC10_statement: model B replaces the cavity flameholder by a constant-cross-sectional tube with the same diameter as the isolator
model_B_corollary.SRC11_statement: parallel experiments replace the cavity flameholder by a constant-area cross-section tube with the same length dimensions as the cavity

coordinate_records.station_3_definition: isolator exit / combustor inlet / most-upstream fuel injection
coordinate_records.solver_coordinate_transform: x_solver = x_source - x_station3; use 0.2914 m when source x is referenced to the SRC10 inlet plane, retaining the 0.03 mm SRC12 dimensional cross-check residual

evidence_boundary: The model-B constant-area replacement and its 35 mm diameter are source-backed.
The 42 mm injector-to-cavity-leading-edge distance is source-backed and remains constant-area in the corresponding model-B location.
SRC12 independently closes the station-3 location: its 37.43 mm inlet plus 254 mm isolator gives 291.43 mm, matching the SRC10 injector coordinate 291.4 mm within 0.03 mm.

SRC12's 296 mm constant-diameter run from inlet end to cavity leading edge equals 254 mm isolator plus 42 mm injector-to-cavity distance exactly, clarifying that these lengths use different endpoints rather than conflicting geometries.

The model-B replacement-tube axial extent is derived from source-stated cavity floor/depth/ramp dimensions and independently cross-checked by two reported overall model lengths; no figure-coordinate digitization is used.
The 2 degree cone angle is still retained as a raw source descriptor; whether it denotes the wall half-angle or included cone angle is not silently assumed.
A formal area profile remains blocked only on the 2 degree cone-angle convention, not on the station-3 coordinate, divergence-start location, or combustor-exit axial location.
next_geometry_evidence_priority: Resolve the 2-degree cone-angle convention from an authoritative geometry definition, source-defined outlet radius/diameter, or an unambiguous original dimensioned figure; do not infer half-angle versus included angle from nomenclature alone.
